program.section_heading: Cosmetology Concepts - Associate of Science Degree and Certificate of Achievement - AS960/AS960C/CE960
outcomes: Deduce valid conclusions, compare, and contrast viable techniques and apply principles in preparation of the California State Board of Barbering and Cosmetology practical and written exam.
Identify and analyze concepts leading to synthesis of theory for the state board written exam. Produce a business plan and portfolio.
Demonstrate entry-level industry skills in a clinic laboratory setting.
Demonstrate workplace behaviors (“soft skills”) necessary for success in the cosmetology industry.
